## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0026-remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def removeDuplicates(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        j = 1

        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] != nums[i-1]:
                nums[j] = nums[i]
                j += 1

        return j
```

</details>
